title: report.json
description: Exact contract. Field names, types, ordering and rounding as stated.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-08-12T18:30:00Z

source_dates.description: Every distinct NAV date loaded, as YYYY-MM-DD, ascending.

schemes_loaded.description: Distinct schemes that made it into the report.

schemes_excluded.description: Distinct schemes you deliberately excluded. Must equal the length of exclusions.

exclusions.description: One entry per excluded scheme. Ordered by amfi_code ascending.

by_amc.description: One entry per AMC present in the NAV data. Ordered by amc ascending (plain string sort).

amc.description: AMC name exactly as it appears in the NAV file.

scheme_count.description: Schemes contributing to the median for this AMC.

median_1d_change_pct.description: Median percentage change, rounded to 4 decimal places. Null if not computable.
